summary: PBF Energy and co-registrant PBF Holding filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, disclosing a private offering of $500.0 million of senior unsecured exchangeable notes due 2032 via PBF Holding and PBF Finance. Net proceeds plus cash will fund the conditional full redemption of all $500 million of 7.875% senior unsecured notes due 2030 at a redemption price of 103.938%; the redemption is conditional. This is a routine refinancing and liability-management transaction, not a special situation; watch for pricing, exchangeable-feature terms and any equity overhang from note settlement.
